methodology.description: Symmetric average of team points scored and opponent points allowed, plus this season’s designated-home scoring margin. Earlier weeks only; no odds or prior-season ratings.
limitations: Direction stability is a leave-one-week-out sensitivity diagnostic, not win probability.
No validated opponent/recency/personnel weighting; exact score is an illustrative point forecast.
Historical method checks use each season independently; official prospective results start with this frozen board.
